issue_context.title: kubectl describe uses Endpoints instead of EndpointSlices
issue_context.body:
### What would you like to be added?

kubectl describe should use **discoveryv1.EndpointSlice** instead of **v1.Endpoints**.

### Why is this needed?

Almost everything in Kubernetes uses endpoint slices instead of endpoints.
This discussion started from https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/123954.

I had to update this as we call **list** on endpointslices rather than **get**, **list** returns zero endpointslices rather than error which **get** endpoint was returning previously.  
After listing endpoints we call **get** on service which throws the error.
I think you meant to squash the last commit into the one before it?
ah, so before your refactoring commit, it wasn't testing `formatEndpoints` at all. ok.
We don't own this file, so I don't know whether SIG CLI will find this an improvement or not... However, this makes it inconsistent with all of the other cases in this file.

I have seen some testcases that assert on the expected output as it is in this file itself
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/b27608875c45218f7a9fa6e9cfdfe17f15328bb2/staging/src/k8s.io/kubectl/pkg/describe/describe_test.go#L2966
